info.title: Furniture Rendering Bulk Backend
info.description: Service-to-service bulk API using private Azure Blob Storage. Upload URLs are 15-minute HTTPS blob-scoped write SAS; PUT raw bytes with the returned Content-Type and x-ms-blob-type: BlockBlob headers, then verify. Download URLs are fresh 15-minute read-only SAS. Persist resource IDs, never SAS URLs. Request uploads only after folder confirmation. Relative paths must not contain empty, dot, dot-dot, backslash or control-character segments. See rendering-backend.md for cross-field constraints and examples.

parameters.name: X-Rendering-Shop
parameters.description: Set by the calling app server from its authenticated Shopify session.

post.description: Resolve full source SKU and unique frame numbers in requested order. Requires explicit shop-scoped catalog grants. Missing rows appear in missingFrames; lookup/storage failures return 503 source_lookup_failed/source_unavailable, changed bytes return 409 source_version_changed. Pins immutable private PNG sources without queuing rendering. Same key replays the original resolution; use a fresh key after source changes. See rendering-cylindo-sources.md.

get.description: Authorize the resolved source in this shop and mint a fresh 15-minute read-only SAS for its pinned PNG. Returns 404 source_not_found for unknown/foreign IDs and 403 source_forbidden for revoked catalog access. Never persist the URL.

post.description: Queues one proof per furniture/fabric combination immediately. Remaining angles require approval. Catalog furniture requires sourceVariantSku, unique frame numbers, and a target variant mapping per combination. Sources array preserves frame order; firstProofSourceId may identify a saved source or verified upload. Source versions and shop grants are checked before acceptance; changed versions return 409 source_version_changed. Invalid mappings return 422 invalid_source_mapping, invalid_frame_mapping or invalid_target_mapping. Same idempotency key/body replays the original job. See rendering-cylindo-sources.md for mixed-source examples and cross-field rules.
